subject: Are you ready to navigate your key staffing milestones?

messages.subject: Are you ready to navigate your key staffing milestones?
messages.body:
https://click.connect.oakridge.edu/events/staffing-milestones Devante, Join the Alumni Network for an insightful session designed to provide founders and operators with a practical framework for what happens when you hit the key staffing milestones of 15, 50 and 100 employees. You will discover which laws apply, which states have strict legislation to watch and what your HR infrastructure should look like to support company growth. Drawing on years of operational leadership, our featured speakers will share real-world experiences navigating these exact kind of moments. From Startup to Scale-Up: The Headcount Thresholds That Will Change Your Company Wednesday, September 2 Noon ET Zoom Webinar https://click.connect.oakridge.edu/events/register Register Now Featuring Julian Mercer (SOM 2010) Founder and Managing Partner, Vanguard People Advisory Marcus Vance Adjunct Professor, School of Management https://click.connect.oakridge.edu/events/register Register by Sept. 1. If you have questions, contact mailto:events@belmont.example events@belmont.example .
